# Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence (MBZUAI)

> MBZUAI is a leading research university in the UAE specializing in artificial intelligence education, research, and enterprise solutions across undergraduate, master's, and doctoral programs.

MBZUAI offers comprehensive AI education from bachelor's to PhD levels, operates multiple research centers focused on computer vision, machine learning, and foundation models, and provides consulting services and business partnerships. The university maintains a strong commitment to scholarships, faculty excellence, and collaborative research initiatives.

## Key Topics

## Academic Programs

- [Undergraduate Program - MBZUAI](https://mbzuai.ac.ae/study/undergraduate-program): Bachelor of Science in AI with business and engineering streams
- [Masters in Artificial Intelligence | AI Masters Degrees](https://mbzuai.ac.ae/study/msc-programs): Master's programs in AI, Computer Science, and Computational Biology
- [PhD in AI | Artificial Intelligence PhD Programs | MBZUAI](https://mbzuai.ac.ae/study/phd-programs): Doctoral programs in Computer Vision, CS, and related AI disciplines
